meta.name: update-skills
meta.description: Re-apply your installed skills to pull their latest code from upstream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重新应用已安装的技能以拉取最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已安装多个技能并希望保持它们最新
copy.tagline_en: Re-apply installed skills to pull their latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have installed skills and want to keep them up-to-date

howto.what: 重新运行已安装技能的自身安装步骤,从上游拉取其最新代码并覆盖本地副本,然后用构建和测试验证更新结果。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中运行 `/update-skills` 命令,且工作树干净、远端已配置好时触发。

say.text: 运行 /update-skills,把已安装的技能都更新到最新版。
say.note: Claude 会检测已安装的技能并让你勾选要更新的。

say.text: 运行 /update-skills 后检查一下构建是否通过。

howto.what_en: This skill re-runs each installed skill's own apply step, fetching its latest code from upstream and overwriting the local copies, then validating the update with build and test.
howto.when_en: This triggers when you run `/update-skills` in Claude Code, with a clean working tree and a configured upstream remote.

say_en.text: Run /update-skills to update all installed skills to the latest.
say_en.note: Claude detects installed skills and lets you choose.

say_en.text: Use /update-skills to re-apply only Slack and Discord, skip the rest.

say_en.note: Claude validates via pnpm build and test.
